theorem doubling_lt_three_halves (h : #(A * A) < (3 / 2 : ℚ) * #A) :
    ∃ (H : Subgroup G) (_ : Fintype H), Fintype.card H < (3 / 2 : ℚ) * #A ∧ ∀ a ∈ A,
      (A : Set G) ⊆ a • H ∧ a •> (H : Set G) = H <• a := by
  let H := invMulSubgroup A h
  refine ⟨H, inferInstance, ?_, fun a ha ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
